chat.say: Sir exams mein bhi mauj karein?

data.asar: Life mein tension kam lo aur kaam ko enjoy karo.
data.caption:
Hitman ka simple funda: Trophy baad mein, pehle mauj! 🏏😎

• Rohit Sharma ne Mumbai Indians ke mindset par khul kar baat ki
• Bole: Trophy ki tension bhool jao, pehle ground par mauj karo
• Hitman ka kehna hai ki jab dimaag chill rahega tabhi bada result aayega

Yeh advice bas Monday morning ko boss ke saamne mat bol dena! 😂

Story pe share karo aur batao: Rohit ki yeh chill philosophy aapko kaisi lagi?
